desc: Implement residue DP in `countSubstrings`: ragged `cnt[m][r]` for m=1..9 over suffixes ending at previous index; per digit x compute new residues (r*10+x)%m including new one-char substring; if x>0 add `new_cnt[x][0]` to answer, if x==0 add nothing; swap counts each step.

Execute the solution on samples "12936","5701283","1010101010" and edge cases "0","1","01","00","10","202"; cross-check with brute-force on random short strings; time n=10^5 — all PASS (11, 18, 25, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 4), random cross-check zero mismatches, n=1e5 ~1s.
Confirmed integer arithmetic uses unbounded Python ints so the answer can exceed 32-bit range.
